findings.current: Las horas están en {timezone}. El envío se realiza en el servidor, aunque este dispositivo no tenga conexión.
findings.proposed: Las horas se muestran en la zona horaria {timezone}. El envío se realiza en el servidor, aunque este dispositivo no tenga conexión.
findings.note: “Las horas están en America/New_York” calques “Times are in”; with a raw IANA identifier as the value, naming “zona horaria” and “se muestran” is how a native writer would say it.

validation.independence: Auditor session e81ede7b8f9d is distinct from translator session c8f3273a539c. All 27 values were read from the working-tree bytes alongside en and the context sidecar, and none of the translator's claims was taken on trust.
validation.semantics: I judged each key in its real UI role, read from team-bridge-scheduled.tsx, team-bridge-page.tsx and team-bridge-rail.tsx (dialog title/aria-label, datetime label, helper text, alerts, the review→confirm primary button, the list heading/nav button, row buttons and the rail draft title/sr-only). Address is tú throughout (Elige, Mantén, Revisa, Actualiza, Puedes, Tu), action labels are infinitives, and everything is in sentence case. Glossary: schedule→programación, device→dispositivo, server→servidor. “Programados” is used for the Scheduled view in schedule.list, failed and success; “Grupos” matches section.groups; “Borrador” matches code_review.draft; “Actualiza” for Refresh matches the app-wide Actualizar; Cancel stays Cancelar. schedule.cancel “Cancelar envío” correctly says delivery is stopped, not that the message is deleted. Uncertainty is kept: “No se confirmó”, “Es posible que ya exista”, “ya se esté enviando”. “Programados” differs from the app-wide “Programaciones” on purpose: it names a different feature.
validation.icu: All 27 values parse with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser, and each argument set equals en: {timezone} in schedule.timezone, {date} in schedule.confirm, none elsewhere. All format with intl-messageformat in locale es. Sample: “¿Enviar el martes, 3 de noviembre de 2026, 9:30:00 GMT-5?” with dateStyle full + timeStyle long, America/New_York. There are no plurals in scope. The file has 136 keys, key order matches en, nothing is missing or extra, and 109/109 base values are byte-identical to HEAD (HEAD es sha 83f83edf…, equal to base_target_sha256; base en sha 92f6c40f… verified; inherited receipt sha b06e9c97… verified).
validation.typography: The raw file is NFC, with no U+200E/F, U+202A–E, U+2066–9 or U+061C. Ellipsis is a real U+2026. Dashes are a spaced em dash U+2014, with no hyphen-for-dash or en dash. The question mark pairs are correct (¿…?) on the full-question string schedule.confirm. There is no space before : ; ? !, no ASCII quotes, no straight apostrophes, no leading or trailing whitespace, no value identical to English, and digits are Latin (“1 minuto”, “120 días”).
validation.overflow: Short visible labels: drafts.indicator “Borrador” is only a title/sr-only next to an icon; schedule.list “Programados” (11 vs 9) and drafts.title “Borradores” (10 vs 6) sit in 30px-high nav buttons and should fit; schedule.reschedule (11) and schedule.cancel (14) are row buttons; schedule.review (20) and schedule.confirm_action (22) are the dialog primary button, so the swap between them barely changes its width; schedule.when “Fecha y hora de envío” (21 vs 7) is a form label in a block above the input, where wrapping is allowed; schedule.retry (35 vs 23) is a ghost button in the full-width composer column. drafts.navigation is aria-label only. None is materially at risk at catalogue level; nav-button fit still needs a rendered check.
